historicalAudit.sample: Completed 2024+ games, excluding tied games from two-way winner metrics
historicalAudit.model: Reconstructed Elo + scoring-form baseline only; advanced overlays not included
historicalAudit.marketDefinition: Retrospective closing two-way American moneyline, converted to no-vig probability
notes: Lower Brier score is better; a positive model-minus-market gap means the model performed worse.
Closing lines are retrospective benchmarks, never input features or proof of an actionable edge.
Season-week block bootstrap intervals account for some within-week correlation; they are approximate.
Historical reconstructions are not originally timestamped pregame forecasts.
Only original archived forward picks establish prospective performance.

notes: Evaluation seasons are used to select the method; they are not an untouched final test.
Coefficients use only completed previous seasons; current-season final scores are excluded from adjustment training.
Signals are correlated and effects are penalised; coefficients are conditional associations, not causal effects.
Closing spread and odds are never used for model training.
A disabled gate means zero probability adjustment; situational flags remain visible.

tacticalValidation.status: RESEARCH — selection results are not prospective approval
tacticalValidation.notes: Ablation uses prior-season data only. Evaluation years were used for selection, not an independent blind test.

lockedHoldout.note: Retrospective date-split check; 2024+ outcomes were already considered in earlier project research, so not an untouched blind experiment.

notes: Historical season-forward evaluation uses only preceding seasons to train each held-out season.
The same games are used for every candidate and baseline, making paired Brier differences comparable.
The 95% week-block bootstrap intervals are exploratory, unadjusted for five comparisons or model selection.
The pre-2024 feature-selection check is simulated retrospectively, NOT genuine untouched prospective evidence.
Historical testing, including the newest seasons, is not untouched blind prospective validation.
A qualified candidate is research-only; live forecasts, markets and player availability weights are unchanged.
Coverage requires nflverse play-by-play from completed earlier games; schedules-only refreshes cannot recompute this audit.
Strictly prior seasons are used in each evaluation; current-season results excluded from activation and coefficients.
Evaluation seasons decide whether to activate: selection is not an independent prospective blind test.
QB starter projections are dated depth-chart observations, not confirmed starters.
OUT/DOUBTFUL is a reported status, not verified gameday inactivity or a causal point deduction.

qbValidation.note: Pre-kickoff QB observations, completed-season model selection, never postgame QB starters. Gate requires >=2 improving years, 350 test games, >=.001 Brier improvement.

qbReplacementResearch.status: research-only; independent QB injury validation unavailable
notes: Historical timestamped depth charts are only sourced from 2025 onward.
Pregame projected QB change is not a verified starter injury or actual replacement.
Historical projection-change screen uses pregame evidence only, never the current-game actual starter.
Current-season results do not enter this historical comparison.
Projected dropbacks × shrunken prior EPA and log-odds mapping are unvalidated assumptions.

additionalInjurySource.note: Additional ESPN media injury watch; not an official NFL weekly practice report or gameday inactive list.

weeklyReports.note: Current season's full-refresh weekly report rows reused. Records lacking original date_modified are first-known at download time and usable only prospectively before kickoff, not retrospectively.

pregameVerificationSource.note: Weekly official game-status fields are accessed from nflverse mirror; no direct NFL.com starting lineup or inactive-list feed is connected. Forecasts on hold cannot trigger value alerts.

qbEvidenceSource.source: ESPN team-specific depthcharts and QB rosters (unofficial)
qbEvidenceSource.notes: ESPN's live depthchart has a QB athlete list that may omit rank fields. A first-listed player is an unconfirmed projection, NOT an explicitly ranked starter. nflverse and ESPN depth charts may share origin. QB rosters are context only, never a starter confirmation. Already completed historical QB plays may be reused for up to 36h. ESPN feed access may fail; missing sources are not imputed.

playerUsageSource.source: nflverse/PFR snap counts via nflreadpy (attribution: CC BY 4.0)

qbReplacementSource.notes: Projected QB change alone never confirms an absence or triggers the full replacement-point adjustment. Conditional scenarios are unvalidated; dated media reporting required for activation.

shadowForwardPerformance.source: Immutable pregame XGBoost challenger picks; ties and late/backfilled entries excluded

forecastRevisionSummary.note: Only original timestamped picks and later forecasts saved before the actual kickoff are scored. Recovered originals retain their original observation time and import provenance. Last recorded does not necessarily mean near kickoff; a separate 24-hour cohort reports true late updates. Ties excluded. No retrospective injury estimates.

playerEffectScorecard.note: Research only. Each game is graded once using the latest genuinely timestamped, fresh, applied player adjustment BEFORE kickoff and its saved same-time non-player probability. Brier gain = without-player error minus adjusted error, so positive is better. Categories can overlap in combined games. Stale cached effects and old snapshots lacking a saved same-time counterfactual are excluded. Any 100-game/two-season threshold triggers independent review, never automatic approval, confidence or a betting signal.

predictionRecord.note: These are real timestamped forward predictions, NOT historical backtests. Every game counts once, irrespective of saved revisions. Original picks never change. Latest means the last actually recorded pre-kickoff pick, not necessarily a game-day estimate. Only official final scores available in nflverse schedules are graded; tied, unplayed, and unverified matches are excluded. Accuracy is favourite-pick win rate. Brier and log loss measure probability quality, and lower is better. Sample sizes below 30 are preliminary.
